'''Jon Dalnaby''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 California State Championship]] on 5 May 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Speed Profit]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2275">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-09-the-bull-at-ca-statesd2275/ the-bull-at-ca-states], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 9 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-09-the-bull-at-ca-statesd2275/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
